name: vzgcoders/ai-router
description: ReactPHP local-first AI model router: tries a local Ollama model first and falls back to Claude, OpenAI and the Copilot CLI, with optional Jev routing and evaluation. Ships a CLI and an OpenAI-compatible HTTP endpoint.

scripts.lint: php -l bin/ai-router && find src tests -name '*.php' -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 php -l

scripts-descriptions.serve: Start the OpenAI-compatible HTTP server for Copilot Chat.
scripts-descriptions.cs: Format PHP source and tests with PHP-CS-Fixer.
scripts-descriptions.unit: Run the PHPUnit unit test suite.
scripts-descriptions.phpacker: Build standalone executables for Windows, macOS and Linux (all architectures) from the PHAR.
